amendment_history.what_changed: the harm sign labels are corrected and split; `signed-true` with a base-protection term is registered beside `signed-exp`; the interference penalty becomes token-aligned; two matched controls become mandatory comparison rows. No win-bar threshold moves.

purpose: Register, before any stage-2b arm is trained, the three corrective supervision weightings (KL-disagreement, signed teacher advantage, both) on the S43 math-weighted 20M stream at the stage-2 budget, with the win bar that decides whether a corrective mechanism replaces the full-distillation bar, the decision rule, and the next route. This file changes no S42 or S43 registration; it instantiates the S43 mechanism at the bar's budget on the bar's stream.

s43_gate_mechanism.role: defines the token gate, the three weights, the preservation penalty and the 2M mechanism screen. Stage-2b is the same mechanism at 20M on the math-weighted stream; the 2M registration is not edited and its decision rule still governs the 2M screen if it is run.

full_bar.role: the 20M full-backbone arm on the same stream and teacher whose anchored score is the bar. No verdict about it is drawn here.

math_stream_amendment.role: the math-weighted stream and its contamination discipline; stage-2b reuses the identical stream, not a new one.

anchored_subset_v2.role: the corrected total-cap basis: MMLU is all 14,042 items. Stage-2b scores on that basis and no other.

stream.mix: 57% math (NuminaMath-CoT 40%, MATH 11%, GSM8K 6%) / 43% FineWeb general, repeated per 10,000-token cycle
stream.why_identical: a stage-2b arm that used a different stream could not be compared with the bar at equal data; the stream is therefore not re-mixed

teacher: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base at b1485b2fa6dfa1287294f269f5fb618e03d52d7c, online, no logit cache, temperature 2.0 for KL and 1.0 for the signed advantage

mechanism.gate: alpha_t = tanh(w . [h_t ; r_t] + b), w = 0 and b = 0 at init

corrective-kl-20m-math.role: the S42/S43 supervision signal at the bar's budget; the like-for-like comparison to the full arm at equal tokens and equal stream

corrective-signed-20m-math.role: the signed teacher advantage A_t = log p_T(y_t) - log p_B(y_t) replaces the KL-disagreement weight; the weight is exp(clamp(A_t, -4, 4)), monotone and always positive, so it suppresses imitation but never reverses it

corrective-signed-true-20m-math.role: the genuinely sign-split variant added by S47: u_t = sigmoid(A_t / tau) with tau = 1.0, plus a token-loss protection term active exactly where A_t < 0. It is a different objective from signed-exp, not an alias

corrective-both-20m-math.role: the registered geometric-mean combination; run only if neither single weighting wins outright

adapter-20m-math-matched.role: the decisive matched-data control: the external memory and the token gate are removed and replaced by a dense residual with exactly the corrective active union; a corrective gain that this arm also has is a data gain, not a mechanism gain

gated-dense-20m-math.gate: the corrective gate: alpha_t = tanh(w . [h_t ; r_t] + b), w = b = 0 at init
gated-dense-20m-math.role: the gate-only control: the same token gate over a dense residual, with no external memory; a corrective gain that this arm also has is a gate gain, not a memory gain

common.why_this_optimizer: the S43 registration fixed AdamW lr 1e-3, constant, warmup 50, clip 1.0 for the corrective arms. Stage-2b keeps it verbatim so a stage-2b result is the same mechanism at a larger budget, not a retune. One seed per arm; the comparison arms (base, adapter-2m/20m, full) are also seed 0.

objective.form: CE + w T^2 sum(u_t KL_t)/sum(u_t) + w preserve_weight T^2 mean(p_t max(KL_t - a_t, 0)) + interference_weight mean(p_t alpha_t^2) + [signed-true only] base_protection_weight mean(1[A_t<0] max(CE_t - CE_base,t, 0))
objective.form_amended_by_s47: the interference penalty is token-aligned, not mean(p_t) mean(alpha_t^2); the base-protection term is added to signed-true only; the three pre-S47 weightings keep their original objective exactly

weights.kl: u_t = a_t / mean(a), a_t = KL(teacher_T || base_T)
weights.signed-true: u_t = sigmoid(A_t / tau), tau = 1.0; 0.5 at a tie, complementary weights for equal-magnitude positive and negative advantages, plus the A_t < 0 token-loss protection term
weights.both: u_t = sqrt(u_kl,t u_signed,t), renormalised to mean 1

init.command: SELVEDGE_MEM=<smoke peak x1.5> SELVEDGE_CPUS=8 SELVEDGE_PIDS=1024 SELVEDGE_TMP=2g scripts/court --gpu oracle -- python3 oracle/frontier/graft.py --corrective --stream-manifest results/stage2/stage2-math-stream-20261117T071120Z.json --seed 0 --vram-limit-gib 12.5 --out-dir results/stage2/graft/corrective
init.why_gpu: the rows are the S40/S42 representation fit read from the student's own hidden states; the fit needs a forward pass. The gate stays exactly zero, so the init itself is bit-identical to the base.
init.one_init_for_three_arms: the three weightings differ only in supervision, so they share one init checkpoint; the file's SHA-256 is recorded in every arm manifest

heldout.metrics: mean next-token CE and mean KL(teacher_T || student_T) at T=2.0 over 3,906 non-overlapping 512-token chunks, paired per chunk against base and against each other
heldout.harm: the corrected three sign masks (teacher_better A>0, base_better A<0, tie A==0) plus the lowest-advantage quartile, with the token count, mean delta KL and fraction worse; reported even when mean CE improves. The pre-S47 label `signed_base_better` was reversed and is not used

anchored_harness.driver: scripts/s40_score.py with --adapter-checkpoint/--memory-checkpoint omitted and --memory-init <corrective init>; the arm is scored through the corrective module, whose gate is trained
anchored_harness.basis: all 14,042 MMLU items, 504 MMLU-Pro, 1,319 GSM8K, 500 MATH-500 (amendment v2)
anchored_harness.table: scripts/s44_arm_table.py re-renders the complete arm table and the paired per-item comparisons against base and adapter-2m; no arm is compared on family means alone
anchored_harness.instrument: docs/anchor-preregistration-v1.json, transformers default attention (sdpa), the one basis on which the stage-2 receipts are comparable

target_family.name: math
target_family.why: the stage-2 measurements put every trained arm below base on math and the loss is concentrated in the generative tasks; math is the family the bar and the mechanism are both supposed to move

win_bar.statement: A stage-2b corrective arm wins only if it beats BOTH the full-distillation bar AND adapter-2m on the target family, at equal tokens, equal stream, equal teacher and equal deployed active union, without buying the gain with a held-out or knowledge regression.
conditions_all_required: 1. math family mean exceeds the full-distillation arm's by more than the combined independent standard error, and the paired per-item bootstrap interval on the math tasks excludes zero in the same direction
2. math family mean exceeds adapter-2m's by more than the combined independent standard error, with the same paired requirement
3. held-out CE delta against base is not positive beyond its paired per-chunk standard error

4. neither registered harm mask shows a positive mean delta KL on the base-match tokens beyond its standard error, and the knowledge family mean is not below base by more than the combined standard error
win_bar.why_adapter: adapter-2m is the cheapest learned correction on the same frozen backbone and active budget; a mechanism that costs the same per token and loses to it is not a mechanism win even if it beats the 20M backbone arm
win_bar.why_equal_active_union: 539,649 against 537,600 is the only accounting difference between the corrective family and the memory/adapter families; a win bought with extra active parameters is reported as such, not as a mechanism win

decision_rule: 1. If one weighting satisfies every win-bar condition, adopt it: that arm becomes the mechanism carried to the next phase, and the other two are recorded as measured alternatives rather than run further.

2. If an arm satisfies conditions 1, 3 and 4 but not 2 (it beats the bar, not the adapter), the finding is 'the residual beats a 20M backbone update at equal tokens but not a 2M adapter'; the next route is a registered adapter-plus-gate comparison, not a new 20M residual variant.

3. If no arm beats the bar but the corrective arm beats base on held-out CE and does not lose the target family beyond its standard error, the 20M correction is real but not on the scored family; the next route is a registered feature-map change (phi adds the base advantage scalar A_t) or dropping the gate conditioning, chosen before the next run.

4. If every corrective arm loses on the target family and on held-out CE, the corrective-residual family is a null at 20M on this stream; the next route is P19.4 (the anchored scoreboard route) and no further residual variant without a new registered mechanism.

next_route.if_a_weighting_wins: score it on the anchored harness beside the full arm and adapter-2m with scripts/s44_arm_table.py; only then is a mechanism claim made
next_route.if_signed_wins: the signed advantage is adopted for the corrective family and the KL-disagreement weight is kept only as the control
next_route.if_all_lose: no further 20M residual arm on this stream; the residual budget is spent and the next phase is the registered scoreboard route
next_route.no_unregistered_retune: lr, schedule, temperature, the three objective weights, the feature map and the stream are fixed by this file; a change is a new registration with its own decision rule

sequencing.why_sequential: one GPU; the memory accounting forbids two memory-heavy jobs at once
sequencing.early_stop: if branch 1 or branch 4 of the decision rule fires after the first arm's held-out and anchored score, the remaining arms are not launched and the reason is receipted
sequencing.bar_first: the full-20m-math arm is scored before any stage-2b arm is launched, so the bar is a measured number and not an expectation

vram.measured_corrective_shape_reference: results/stage2/runs/memory-2m/log.jsonl: 9.211 GiB allocated / 9.363 GiB reserved peak, the same student+teacher+residual forward/backward shape
vram.measured_full_arm_reference: results/stage2/runs/full-20m-math/launch.json: 11.4289 GiB allocated / 11.672 GiB reserved at a 12.5 GiB limit
vram.arithmetic: 9.363 GiB reserved + the gate's 2,049 parameters (16 KiB) + one (B, T) float gate and its backward (512 x 4 bytes x 2, per micro-batch) + allocator slack < 12.5 GiB; no reduction is expected to be needed
ladder_if_over: sequence 512 -> 384 with gradient accumulation 4 -> 5 (keeps 1,920 tokens/step, needs an amendment because the registered schedule changes)
sequence 384 -> 256 with accumulation 5 -> 8 (2,048 tokens/step, same amendment)
micro-batch stays 1: raising it is not in the ladder

container.sizing_rule: SELVEDGE_MEM = 1.5 x the arm's own smoke cgroup peak, never below measured + 1 GiB; the launcher refuses to run without it
container.reference: the full arm's 20-step smoke measured 6.449 GiB cgroup peak at a 12 GiB bound with no reclaim, and its launch used 10 GiB (1.55x)
container.expected: the corrective arm's host side is the same python + stream mmap as the memory arm; a 20-step smoke is run first and sizes the launch

sizing.reservation: before each launch, host MemAvailable must exceed the new container's limit plus 4 GiB; the full arm holds about 10 GiB until it exits, so stage-2b starts only after the bar run's unit is inactive

files: oracle/tests/test_s44_stage2b.py (the three entry points, the accounting, determinism, and the launcher-to-registration consistency)
claims: each of the three weightings runs a CPU training step: finite loss, a non-zero gate after the step, non-zero gradients on the gate, the rows, the key and value projections
two identical seeded runs of one step produce bit-identical losses and identical post-step parameters
the corrective active union is 539,649 and the memory union is 537,600, a difference of 2,049 per site
the untrained corrective arm reproduces the base logits bit for bit
the signed advantage is positive where the teacher is better on the target and negative where the base is
the sign masks split positive, negative and zero exactly and the old reversed label is gone
signed-true weights A>0 above 0.5, A<0 below 0.5 and A==0 at exactly 0.5, and the base-protection term is active only where A<0
the token-aligned interference penalty distinguishes two gate/preservation configurations with identical means
the matched controls have exactly 539,649 active added parameters and the gated dense residual is the base bit for bit at init
the launcher's registered arguments match this file (weighting, tokens, seed, stream hash, run dir)
tests.receipt: recorded with the S44 court run

what_this_file_does_not_establish: that any corrective arm beats the bar: that is the experiment, and the bar is not yet scored
that 20M corrective tokens are enough for the gate to open usefully: the 2M screen has not been run either
that the signed advantage is less noisy than the KL-disagreement weight at 20M
that the feature map [h ; r] is optimal: it is the registered first map at a 2,049-element cost per site
that one seed per arm identifies a mechanism effect: the intervals are per-item sampling intervals, not seed variance
